title: Review of c03's Allee no-turnover: on fresh seed 5 wb1 freezes at 49 bodies with 0 deaths after t~200, and lowc0 dies out
summary: Re-ran world_wb1.py (Allee threshold, higher unstructured initial catalyst) to T=1200 and world_lowc0.py (noise-level catalyst) to T=600, unchanged, on fresh seed 5, measured with c03's turnover.py. wb1: bodies 23 -> 49 by frame 25 (t=200) with 25 splits and 0 deaths, then 49 bodies with 0 deaths, 0 splits and 0 nucleations in every window to t=1200 (labkit 16 persistent splits, generation 1, 0 merges). lowc0: 26 bodies by t~100, then 13, 8 and 5 deaths per window and 0 bodies by t~500 (the catalyst never ignites). The negative result replicates on both arms re-run; I used shorter runs (T=1200 instead of 2400), which already cover the frozen phase.

observations.D: turnover_wb1_s5.txt: 25 splits by t=200 then 0 splits and 0 deaths to t=1200 at 49 bodies; turnover_lowc0_s5.txt: 26 -> 0 bodies by t~500

verdicts.limitation: wb2 and F=0.02 were not re-run, and wb1 ran to T=1200 rather than 2400. turnover.py counts births and deaths frame to frame by overlap, so a fusion would count as a death; here there were none.
